tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: thugs rje chen po'i bka' srung rdo rje legs pa sman btsun lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so:

thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo: dam can skyes bu chen po dang sman btsun rdo rje g.yu sgron ma gnyis kyi sgrub thabs la: gnas gtsang mar stegs bu'i khar stag lpags bkram pa'i steng du zas sna tshogs las byas pa'i gtor ma mkhar thabs kyi dbyibs can gru gsum dmar po: dkar po zlum po: 'khor rang 'dra ba bzhi res bskor ba: de la mda' rgod sgro ma gnyis la le brgan dmar po: stag gzig gi cod pan: zangs kyi khrab byang: rin po che sna tshogs: dar la bris pa'i sku: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar yab la tri: yum la bh+yo: mtha' mar srog sngags: rtsibs bzhi la: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: mu khyud la: so so'i mtshan gyi mthar: rten 'dir brtan par bzhugs la bdag gi phrin las ci bcol thams cad sgrubs shig: ces bri: pha waṃ long bu la triḥdang: mu men la bh+yoḥyis mtshan pa: zangs kyi gwa'ur bcug: ra dang sha ba yu mo'i snying gi nang du'ang srog sngags gzhug: mda' dar gyi rke la btags pa gtor ma la gzug: mchod rdzas spyan gzigs rgyas par bsham: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yan lag bdun pa rnams bya: bgegs bskrad: mtshams bcad: srung 'khor bsgom: rang nyid thugs rje chen por bsgom zhing: rten rdzas rnams dam can yab yum du bskyed: bdag gi hrīḥlas 'od 'phros: dam can yab yum gyi thugs srog la phog: sngon gyi dam tshig dran nas ci bsgo ba'i las sgrub par bsam: oṃ badz+ra sā dhu sa ma ya bka traṃ traṃ shi ni kra ma ni dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: yab kyi srog snying dang: oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki ma nu rak+to sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: yum gyi srog snying de gnyis gzugs ma mthong gi bar bzla: gtor ma 'bul: phrin las bcol: lha rnams rten la bstim: dben par bzhag la rgyun tu mchod bstod bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: las sbyor ni: ra'i pags pa bting ba'i khar ra sha ra khrag gis brgyan pa'i gtor ma la sku gzugs dang: mdung dar btsugs:

mtha' skor du zan gyi a tsa ra'i gzugs 'jigs su rung ba: wa dang khyi ngu ba sogs: cho 'phrul gyi gzugs bkram: mchod pa spyan gzigs rgyas par bsham: rang nyid rta mgrin du bsgom: mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la: dam can 'khor bcas bskyed: rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer dam can gyi thugs kar phog: thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bar bsam la: hūm̐: skyes bu chen po dam tshig can: gson cig dgongs shig rdzu 'phrul can: dam ldan rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: srung ma chen po khyod nyid la: mchod mchod bstod bstod gsol gsol nas: lan gcig phrin las dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bo sdig can la: a tsar mon pa'i cho 'phrul phob: ming nas 'bod cing ngu brang rdungs: ka ca 'di zhes gtod ces pa'i: 'o dod 'bod pa'i cho 'phrul thongs: 'ug pa rgod cing wa mo brgyal: dred mong lag dkar thal mo rdeb: sgo khyi ngu dang nang 'thab byed: 'phar ba gcan spyang mang po rgyug: thog dang ser ba 'od dmar 'khyugs: cho 'phrul sna tshogs gtong bar gyis: khyod la mthu rtsal ci 'dug lta: nga la lha med zer zhing gshe: khyod la mthu med zer zhing smod: dben gnas gnyan po bcom la nye: le lo btang snyoms ma mdzad par: ka ca bsrung phyir cho 'phrul phob: ces bskul zhing ra gsur gtong: ra rkang 'bud: ra lpags rdeb: dgra bo'i ming shes na dang: ma shes na ka ca 'di zhes khyer ba'i mi de la cho 'phrul 'di lta bu zhig thongs shig ces dmod pa lan brgya phrag stong gi bar du bya'o: mtshan thog thag la'ang bzla'o: dmigs pa ni rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros dam can gyi thugs kar phog: thugs cher khros: a tsa ra mon pa smra shes sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs sku las 'phros: gzugs rnams la thim: zang zing lang long du rgyug par bsam la: bskul dang phrin las bcol: rab dngos su: 'bring nyams: tha ma rmi lam sogs su gzugs brnyan de rnams rgyug pa: skad thos pa sogs 'byung ngo:

de'i tshe na dam can la gtor ma bzang du 'bul zhing bskul dang dmod bcol byas la gzugs kyang ring por 'jog pa'am: yang na rkun ma'i sgo dang rgyab ri'i rtse sogs la bzhag: shin tu thag ring na de phyogs su 'phang: de lta bu'i cho 'phrul song bar bsam: rtags byung na dam can la gtang rag gtang ngo: lan gcig gis ma byung na slar yang spogs chog bya'o: thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor pa sgrub pa snying nas byed pa: dam can rgyun du bsten mchod mkhan dag gis 'grub pa las: gzhan gyis 'grub par mi 'gyur ro: dam tshig nyams pas 'di byas na 'khu ldog 'byung bas gzab 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: yang sman btsun chen mo'i sgo nas me long pra sgrub ni: phug pa mi khyi'i skad mi thos pa'i sar song la: stegs bu'i khar sman btsun gyi rten rdzas rnams bsham: dkar gsum gyi mchod pa du ma bshams la: me long gsal ba zhig gtor ma la btags: srog sngags kyi mthar: ma mo chen mo snang srid gsal bar ston ston: nyin mtshan sbrel la bzlas shing: rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros: sman btsun gyi thugs kar phog: de yi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros me long la phog pas snang srid gsal ba'i me long du gyur: de la gang 'dod pa'i don thams cad shar bar bsam: bh+yo: sman btsun rdo rje g.yu sgron ma: ming po bdag gis khyod bsgrubs pa'i: re ba'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: snang srid gsal ba'i me long gis: thams cad shes pa'i mngon shes dang: pra yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: zhes bskul zhing dmigs pa bzlas pa gong bzhin no: rab dngos: 'bring nyams: tha ma rmi lam las don rnams shes par 'gyur ro: don grub nas sman btsun rten la bstim: mchod pa rnams sbas la bzhag go: 'di ltar skyes bu yab yum mthu che: dngos grub myur: phrin las thogs pa med: snying nye: bkra shis pa'o: o rgyan pad+ma bdag gi rjes 'jug rnams kyis srung ma 'di rang la gyis shig:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ༁ྃ: thugs rje chen po'i bka' srung rdo rje legs pa lcam dral gyi phrin las bzhugs so: ༁ྃ: thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo: de yi bka' srung rdo rje legs pa lcam dral mchod cing sgrub par 'dod pas mchod gtor dang spyan gzigs rgyas par bshams la: rang nyid thugs rje chen por bsgoms la: thugs ka nas raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros: mchod rdzas spyan gzigs rnams kyi ma dag pa sbyangs: gnas khang phun sum tshogs pa'i nang du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che dang bhañdza'i snod rnams su oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las 'dod yon bza' btung bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin mthun pa'i rdzas rnams: gzugs mdzes pa: sgra snyan pa: dri zhim pa: ro mngar ba: reg bya 'jam pa: ngo mtshar ba'i bkod pa ye shes kyi rol pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin du 'char bar gyur: mdun du lha mi'i yul phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su pha wang long bu'i sku mkhar brjid cing mdzes pa'i nang du tri las skyes mchog badz+ra sā dhu sku mdog dmar po sma ra smin ma me ltar 'bar zhing zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gnyis bgrad pa: phyag g.yas rdo rje dang: g.yon pas dgra snying 'dzin pa: dar sngon gyi gos dang dar dmar gyi ber lhab lhub tu mnabs pa: dbu la thang zhu dmar po rdo rje'i tog dang le brgan gyis brgyan pa: zhabs la sag lham gsol zhing seng ge la 'chib pa: g.yon du bh+yo las rdo rje g.yu sgron ma dkar mo dar gyi na bza' lhab lhub dang rin po che yis brgyan pa: mda' dar dang me long 'dzin nas sha ba yu mo la 'chib pa de gnyis kyi 'khor du mched zla sum brgya drug cu: dgyes sde brtan ma bcu gnyis: zab gter bka' yi srung ma rnams kyis bskor ba'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: snying kha'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin dang gar bzhugs pa'i gnas nas skyes bu chen po sman btsun 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs:

ra gsur bya zhing dar dmar g.yab: kye: ya ki gtsang gi zam bu lung: ma ki rong mdo brag dmar dang: dbu ru zhwa yi lha khang nas: dam can skyes bu thig le rtsal: deng gi gnas mchog dam pa 'dir: phrin las sgrub phyir gshegs su gsol: pha ki pho brang smyug ri dang: jo mo snying phyug gnas brgyad nas: che zhe chen mo g.yu sgron ma: sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu dang: dgyes sde brtan ma bcu gnyis dang: bod yul gter gyi srung ma rnams: mchod phyir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sā dhu badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐: rten gyi sku mkhar mdzes pa dang: rin chen khri mchog brjid ldan la: dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: shākya thub pa'i bstan pa 'dir: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' srung mchog: lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la bstod: gtsang ma'i khrus dang spos kyi sprin: snang gsal 'od 'bar byugs pa'i dri: spyan gzigs dkor cha sna tshogs dang: sha chang sgog btsong spod kyi rigs: dkar gsum mngar gsum shing tog 'bru: zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i tshogs: bstod dbyangs sil snyan rol mo dkrol: bdud rtsi sman dang rak+ta dang: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas kyis: dam can 'khor bcas dgyes gyur cig: sman btsun 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas: shab+da pū dza kā ma gu ṇa pañtsa a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: oṃ badz+ra sā dhu sa ma ya bka traṃ traṃ shi ni kra ma ni sa ma ya sā dhu tri dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: badz+ra ḍā ki nī ma nu rak+to sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: ho dgongs su gsol lo: dam can skyes bu chen po khyod ni thugs rje chen po'i bka' sdod dbang chen rta mgrin gyi sprul pa: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka'i bya ra ba: zab gter kun gyi bdag po: bod yul lha 'dre'i gtso bo:

dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma: bar chad bgegs kyi gnyen po: gsang sngags zab mo spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi grogs po: yum sman btsun ma g.yu'i sgron ma: mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu: dgyes sde brtan ma bcu gnyis: zab gter bka'i srung ma: yang sprul pho nya dang bcas pa rnams la gsol lo: mchod do: dgyes pa'i zhal ston: sgrub pa'i rtags phyungs: bka' dang bstan pa gnyan po srungs: rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad zhi ba dang: tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod thams cad spel: gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad cham la phob: ci 'dod pa'i phrin las thams cad myur du 'grub par mdzod cig: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings su mngon par sangs rgyas nas: mi g.yo bzhin du rta mgrin thugs las sprul: rdo rje theg pa'i rig 'dzin sa la gnas: dregs pa'i skur ston khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: chags med bde chen rgyas pa'i sku mdog dmar: zhe sdang gnas 'gyur khro zhing gtum pa'i tshul: ma rig rang gsal ye shes dpa' rtsal rgyas: chos skyong chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdud sde pham mdzad ye shes rdo rje phyar: nyon mongs rab 'joms dam nyams tsit+ta gsol: kun la dbang sgyur dar dmar ber chen mnabs: khams gsum dbang sdud khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: sangs rgyas bstan srung thang zhu rdo rje'i tog: dbang rtags le brgan cod pan pu ru ru: phrin las myur sgrub seng ge rtsal ldan 'chib: sgrub po'i bka' srung khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: gsang sngags srung ma yongs kyi gtso mo ni: che zhe chen mo srid pa'i yid 'phrog ma: rdzu 'phrul thogs med phrin las rnam bzhi'i bdag: rdo rje g.yu sgron ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: snang srid gsal ba'i me long g.yas na 'dzin: tshe g.yang dngos grub stsol ba'i mda' dar g.yon: las la thogs med sha ba yu mo 'chib: rdzu 'phrul thogs med ldan la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam can khyod kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i:

sum brgya drug cu dgyes sde brtan ma'i tshogs: slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan sngar dam bcas pa'i: zab gter bka' yi srung ma rnams la bstod: zhes brjod cing phrin las ci 'dod gsol: gtor ma gtsang sar 'bul zhing: lha rnams rten la bstim pa'am rang gnas su gshegs: rjes kyi spyod lam spyi ltar bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: 1$0000230sprul pa'i gter chen mchog gyur bde chen gling pas 'bum rdzong gu ru'i gsang phug nas khrom gter du spyan drangs pa'o/// /
